## Continuity, failures, and durable findings

- Fresh GitHub REST evidence was collected for all 114 unique PRs represented by
  the 122 Stage-3-owned immutable records immediately before ledger generation.
- Fifteen non-merged changed-head records returned to Stage 1 as `STALE_ANCHOR`;
  current live heads were never written over immutable historical keys.
- Terminal records were projected without reopening PRs or repeating GitHub
  actions: 48 matching-head closed-without-merge and 14 merged. Twelve merged
  records with post-merge live-head drift retained their existing immutable keys
  under lesson 0gp.
- `personal-config` #2116 and #2054 returned to Stage 1 for post-merge cooldown
  and canonical replacement verification; merged replacements alone did not
  authorize same-run source closure.
- `Seatek_Analysis` #809 remains protected by `HOLD_PLATFORM`: the failed AI
  review job rejected an unsupported model before repository analysis, while
  ordinary source tests and checks passed. No application or security gate was
  weakened.
- Durable lesson 0gz records unsupported pre-analysis review models as platform
  holds; lesson 0gy records raw/blob retrieval for Contents responses that omit
  bodies above 1 MB.
- Existing documentation lineages #2097 and #2117 were reused; no third
  overlapping documentation PR was created. Appending this report after the
  ledger CAS intentionally changes #2117's docs-only head for the next Stage 1
  re-ingest.
- Recurring schedules, repository settings, branch protections, and product
  branches were not modified.

## Ledger write verification

- Revision 66 passed schema/runtime validation before the first CAS, which used
  fresh revision-65 blob `1574457f72769d726d26f39771c94ad1c1cb1ad1` and produced
  blob `a89024ce6cf1e7f8c9d5b4dcd3af47c89d02e8ec`, commit
  `deb5ccdf03201d12589b01472751e81553077723`.
- Pre-commit review found that 12 already-merged changed-head records had to
  retain their existing keys under lesson 0gp rather than remain Stage 1

  and terminalized the records without mutating their historical anchors.
- The correction CAS used fresh revision-66 blob
  `a89024ce6cf1e7f8c9d5b4dcd3af47c89d02e8ec` and produced final blob
  `e65a86935d8bc2567eda938c392d30948ddb01ee`, commit
  `bcb21c46fc21b96714f949bbaea407b5c9d1a350`.
- The final remote file was re-read from `automation/pr-lifecycle-ledger`,
